children: DALLAS, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Braemar Hotels & Resorts Inc. (

) ("Braemar" or the "Company") today announced that its Board of Directors (the "Board") declared a quarterly cash dividend for the fourth quarter ending December 31, 2026 for the Company's 5.5% Series B Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock equal to: $0.3438 per share, which will be paid on January 15, 2027 to stockholders of record as of December 30, 2026.

The Board declared a quarterly cash dividend for the fourth quarter ending December 31, 2026 for the Company's 8.25% Series D Cumulative Preferred Stock equal to: $0.5156 per share, which will be paid on January 15, 2027 to stockholders of record as of December 31, 2026.

The Board declared a monthly cash dividend for all CUSIPs of the Company's Series E Redeemable Preferred Stock, payable as follows: $0.15625 per share will be paid on November 16, 2026, to stockholders of record as of October 30, 2026; $0.15625 per share will be paid on December 15, 2026 to stockholders of record as of November 30, 2026; and $0.15625 per share will be paid on January 15, 2027 to stockholders of record as of December 31, 2026.

The Board declared a monthly cash dividend for CUSIPs 10482B705 and 10482B887 of the Company's Series M Redeemable Preferred Stock payable as follows: $0.18125 per share will be paid on November 16, 2026, to stockholders of record as of October 30, 2026; $0.18125 per share will be paid on December 15, 2026 to stockholders of record as of November 30, 2026; and $0.18125 per share will be paid on January 15, 2027 to stockholders of record as of December 31, 2026.

The Board declared a monthly cash dividend for CUSIPs 10482B796, 10482B861, 10482B770 and 10482B846 of the Company's Series M Redeemable Preferred Stock payable as follows: $0.17917 per share will be paid on November 16, 2026 to stockholders of record as of October 30, 2026; $0.17917 per share will be paid on December 15, 2026 to stockholders of record as of November 30, 2026; and $0.17917 per share will be paid on January 15, 2027 to stockholders of record as of December 31, 2026.

The Board declared a monthly cash dividend for CUSIP 10482B820 of the Company's Series M Redeemable Preferred Stock payable as follows: $0.17708 per share will be paid on November 16, 2026, to stockholders of record as of October 30, 2026; $0.17708 per share will be paid on December 15, 2026 to stockholders of record as of November 30, 2026; and $0.17708 per share will be paid on January 15, 2027 to stockholders of record as of December 31, 2026.

As of September 30, 2026, there were 8,150,132 shares of the Company's Series E Redeemable Preferred Stock and 1,269,981 shares of the Company's Series M Redeemable Preferred Stock issued and outstanding, and there were an additional 2,448,062 shares of the Company's Series E Redeemable Preferred Stock and 91,129 shares of the Company's Series M Redeemable Preferred Stock issued and outstanding for which redemption requests have been received but have not been fully processed.

) is a real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on the high-growth luxury hotel and resort sector. Its industry-leading portfolio features luxury properties across the United States and the U.S. territories in the Caribbean.
